_about: Registry for scripts/record_signals.py (Nov 11, 2026, research only). Reviewed edits only: an entry is added by a pull request that also carries its pre-registration (readme) and the four uniqueness checks of docs/STRATEGY_LIFECYCLE.md section 7d. The script ignores any entry that fails validation and records nothing for an entry whose enabled is not true.

_template.id: 2 to 12 capitals or digits, e.g. WXHIGH1
_template.url: https://<host on the script's ALLOWLIST>/<path>  (a host not on the list is a code edit in scripts/record_signals.py)
_template.parse: {"type": "json", "path": ["key", 0, "key"]} or {"type": "csv", "column": 3, "row": "last"}  (row: first, last or a number)
_template.kalshi: {"ticker": "KXBTC15M-..."} or {"series": "KXBTC15M"} (the open market that closes soonest)
_template.cadence: run (every start) or day (only the first start of the UTC day)
_template.enabled: false until the owner approves the entry; the logger records nothing for it otherwise
